{{Top|leg}}
'''Drive motors''' were part of an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport's]] walking mechanism. Two drive motors were located beneath the main body section of the [[Walker/Legends|walker]], driving the war machine's four legs at a top speed of sixty [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] per [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] over flat terrain.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>

Damage to the drive motors could make the [[Walker/Legends|walker]] move faster, which it was not generally designed to do.
